FN-WTA4EE5-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 122
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Commissions Underwood
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 122 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Physical Therapy
until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
